title: Strictly semistable relative curves
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. A strictly semistable $T$-curve is a scheme $Y$ with a morphism $f:Y\to T$ which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], such that every fibre $Y_t$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is purely one-dimensional [def-weil-pure-dimension], together with the following local-chart condition. For every $y\in Y$ there are an open $U\subset Y$ containing $y$, an affine open $B\subset T$, a commutative ring $A$ and an isomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}A\simeq B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with $f(U)\subset B$, and an etale $T$-morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] from $U$ to either $\operatorname{Spec}A[t]$ or $\operatorname{Spec}(A[u,v]/(uv-a))$ for some $a\in A$, with the standard structure map induced by the inclusion of coefficients. Here the polynomial algebras are as in [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. No separatedness or properness of $Y\to T$ is imposed.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact general notion or duplicate declaration. Blueprint searches strict semistable and strictly semistable: 0 hits. Schematic density occurs inline in NagataSketchClosure, not as a predicate. Orgogozo.IsModification is restricted to reduced, locally Noetherian compact targets and uses topological density. NodalFamilyEtaleLocalModel gives a universal nodal model over Z[a], not strict semistability. MultipointedCurve additionally specifies a marking. PureDimension already gives fibrewise pure dimension and is reused.
